description: SvFileUpload in Svelte 5: a drag-and-drop file field with click to browse, accept, maxSize and maxFiles validation whose rejections fire onReject, and a selected-files list. It carries the shared editor contract with a label, a hint and required or error validation, so it drops into a form like any other input; the demo uses it for a required avatar limited to images.
keywords: svelte 5 drag and drop file input

faq.question: How are rejected files reported?
faq.answer: Files that fail accept, maxSize or maxFiles are not added to the value; onReject receives them with a reason so you can show a message, as the demo does under the field.

faq.question: Does it upload the files?
faq.answer: No. It collects File objects through onChange; you send them with fetch or FormData when the form submits, which keeps the component free of network assumptions.

faq.question: Can users remove a selected file?
faq.answer: Yes. Each entry in the list has a remove button, and the value updates through onChange.
